request.query: maximal intersecting family of subsets of a finite set has cardinality 2^(n-1)

response.query: maximal intersecting family of subsets of a finite set has cardinality 2^(n-1)

matches.name: Finset.card_biUnion_le_of_intersecting
matches.signature:
theorem Finset.card_biUnion_le_of_intersecting (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Finset (Finset α))
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i : Set (Finset α)).Intersecting) :
    #(s.biUnion f) ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card α - 2 ^ (Fintype.card α - #s)
matches.docstring:
**Kleitman's theorem**. An intersecting family on `n` elements contains at most `2ⁿ⁻¹` sets, and
each further intersecting family takes at most half of the sets that are in no previous family.

matches.name: Finset.powersetCard
matches.signature: def powersetCard (n : ℕ) (s : Finset α) : Finset (Finset α)
matches.docstring:
Given an integer `n` and a finset `s`, then `powersetCard n s` is the finset of subsets of `s`
of cardinality `n`.

matches.name: Set.Finite.finite_subsets
matches.signature: theorem Finite.finite_subsets {α : Type u} {a : Set α} (h : a.Finite) : { b | b ⊆ a }.Finite
matches.docstring: There are finitely many subsets of a given finite set

matches.name: Set.IsIntersectingOf
matches.signature: def IsIntersectingOf (L : Set ℕ) (𝒜 : Set (Finset α)) : Prop
matches.docstring:
A family `𝒜` of finite subsets of `α` is `L`-intersecting if the intersection size of every pair of
distinct members of `𝒜` belongs to `L ⊆ ℕ`.

That is, for all `s, t ∈ 𝒜` with `s ≠ t`, we have `|(s ∩ t)| ∈ L`.

matches.name: Set.Intersecting
matches.docstring: A set family is intersecting if every pair of elements is non-disjoint.

matches.name: Set.Intersecting.exists_card_eq
matches.signature:
theorem Intersecting.exists_card_eq (hs : (s : Set α).Intersecting) :
    ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ 2 * #t = Fintype.card α ∧ (t : Set α).Intersecting

matches.name: Set.Intersecting.card_le
matches.signature:
theorem Intersecting.card_le [Fintype α] {s : Finset α} (hs : (s : Set α).Intersecting) :
    2 * #s ≤ Fintype.card α

matches.name: Set.IsIntersectingOf.mono
matches.signature: theorem mono (h : L ⊆ L') (hL : IsIntersectingOf L 𝒜) : IsIntersectingOf L' 𝒜
matches.docstring: An `L`-intersecting family is also `L'`-intersecting whenever `L ⊆ L'`.

matches.name: Set.IsIntersectingOf.empty
matches.signature: theorem empty : IsIntersectingOf L (∅ : Set (Finset α))
matches.docstring:
The empty family of finite sets is `L`-intersecting, vacuously, because it contains no pairs of
sets.

matches.name: Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq
matches.signature:
theorem Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq (hs : (s : Set α).Intersecting) :
    (∀ t : Finset α, (t : Set α).Intersecting → s ⊆ t → s = t) ↔ 2 * #s = Fintype.card α

matches.name: Set.IsIntersectingOf.univ
matches.docstring: Every family of finite sets is `univ`-intersecting.

matches.name: Set.IsIntersectingOf.anti
matches.signature: theorem anti (h : ℬ ⊆ 𝒜) (h𝒜 : IsIntersectingOf L 𝒜) : IsIntersectingOf L ℬ
matches.docstring: An `L`-intersecting family remains `L`-intersecting under restriction to any subfamily.
